record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Can one find a direct connection between the representation-theoretic vertex-operator-algebra approach to conformal field theory and the conformal-net approach, and prove that the two approaches are equivalent at least for rational conformal field theories?

evidence.quote: There are many different methods for the study of conformal field theories. But they can all be classified as belonging to one of two types of methods. The first type is the method of the representation theory of vertex operator algebras. The other is the method of conformal nets.

Problem 9.1. Find a direct connection between the method of the representation theory of vertex operator algebras and the method of conformal nets. Prove that at least for rational conformal field theories, they are equivalent.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Two mathematically rigorous frameworks for chiral two-dimensional conformal field theory exist:

(1) The representation-theoretic approach via vertex operator algebras (VOAs): a VOA is a $\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$-graded complex vector space $V = \bigoplus_{n \geq 0} V_n$ equipped with a state-field correspondence $Y(\cdot,z): V \to \mathrm{End}(V)[[z,z^{-1}]]$, a vacuum vector, and a Virasoro (conformal) vector, satisfying the standard locality, vacuum, translation, and Virasoro axioms. A unitary rational VOA $V$ has a finite, semisimple, modular tensor category $\mathrm{Rep}(V)$ of admissible representations.

(2) The conformal-net approach: a (local) conformal net $\mathcal{A}$ on $S^1$ is an assignment $I \mapsto \mathcal{A}(I)$ of a von Neumann algebra to each proper open interval $I \subset S^1$, satisfying isotony, locality (commuting algebras for disjoint intervals), Möbius/diffeomorphism covariance with positive energy, vacuum existence and cyclicity, and irreducibility. A completely rational conformal net has a unitary modular tensor category $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathcal{A})$ of Doplicher–Haag–Roberts superselection sectors.

Problem. Construct a direct, functorial correspondence between unitary VOAs and conformal nets on $S^1$. In particular, prove that for every unitary rational VOA $V$ there exists a completely rational conformal net $\mathcal{A}_V$ such that the modular tensor category $\mathrm{Rep}(V)$ is equivalent (as a unitary modular tensor category) to $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathcal{A}_V)$, and conversely every completely rational conformal net arises this way; thereby establishing the equivalence of the two approaches in the rational case.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made but the problem is not fully resolved. Carpi, Kawahigashi, Longo, and Weiner (Mem. AMS 254 (2018), arXiv:1503.01260) constructed a general procedure associating a conformal net $\mathcal{A}_V$ to every "strongly local" unitary VOA $V$, and established a correspondence between unitary subalgebras and covariant subnets. However, strong locality has not been proven for all unitary (rational) VOAs, and the conjectured equivalence of the modular tensor categories $\mathrm{Rep}(V) \simeq \mathrm{Rep}(\mathcal{A}_V)$ in the rational case remains an open conjecture, with verifications only in specific families (e.g., certain holomorphic VOAs, lattice and affine examples). Thus the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: From vertex operator algebras to conformal nets and back
status_evidence.snippet: General procedure associating a conformal net A_V to every strongly local unitary VOA V; one-to-one correspondence between unitary subalgebras and covariant subnets.
status_evidence.claim: A direct construction from (strongly local) VOAs to conformal nets is established, providing partial progress toward equivalence.

status_evidence.title: Haploid Algebras in C*-Tensor Categories and the Schellekens List
status_evidence.snippet: Holomorphic VOAs are shown to be strongly local in the sense of Carpi-Kawahigashi-Longo-Weiner, yielding new holomorphic conformal nets.
status_evidence.claim: Further families of VOAs have been shown strongly local, but equivalence of modular tensor categories in the rational case remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Conformal Field Theory, Operator Algebras and Vertex Operator Algebras (Kawahigashi)
status_evidence.snippet: Main conjecture in rational CFT: the unitary modular tensor category associated to V is equivalent to that of the corresponding conformal net A_V.
status_evidence.claim: The equivalence of modular tensor categories between V and A_V in the rational case is still a conjecture.
